basis.by: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development

basis.title: UFM 3-601-02 Fire Protection Systems Inspection, Testing, and Maintenance (Unified Facilities Manual, 13 March 2026)
basis.by: U.S. Department of Defense (Unified Facilities Criteria program)
basis.label: "LED egress marking devices without battery backup are considered to have a 25-year service life. (Consult the manufacturer's technical materials for specific guidance.)"
basis.note: Printed page 76. LED exit signs (egress marking devices) without battery backup, i.e. powered from an emergency/generator circuit. Battery-backed units need battery or unitized-fixture replacement every 5 to 10 years per manufacturer guidance (p.83, not transcribed as a life), so this value does not describe battery-backed signs.

open_questions: Every source here is a published planning, design or accounting life. None is observed replacement data.
